name: Deep squat hold
instructions: Stand barefoot with your feet about hip to shoulder width apart and toes turned out a little.
Sink into the deepest squat you can, hips below your knees and both heels flat on the floor.
Do not hold on to anything. Your arms can rest on your knees or reach forward.
Start a timer and stay in the bottom as long as you stay relaxed and your heels stay down.
Stop the timer when you stand up, lift a heel, sit down or need a hand for support.
